asks.ask: 각 배치 200–450 °C 구간 질량 변화량(W200 − W450, wt%)을 계산해서 범례 라벨에 같이 넣어 주세요.

code:
import numpy as np
lines = ax1.get_lines()
labels = []
for line in lines:
    orig_label = line.get_label()
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    
    # Filter valid points within range to ensure interpolation works correctly if needed, 
    # but np.interp handles out-of-bounds by clamping. We just need the values at 200 and 450.
    w200 = np.interp(200, x_data, y_data)
    w450 = np.interp(450, x_data, y_data)
    delta_w = w200 - w450
    new_label = f"{orig_label} (ΔW: {delta_w:.2f} wt%)"
    labels.append(new_label)

# Update legend with new labels
legend = ax1.legend(labels=labels, loc='best')
plt.setp(legend.get_texts(), fontsize='small')
